fr_blurb: One account, on this machine. There is no cloud login, and nothing you type here leaves the building.
fr_password_help: At least twelve characters. A sentence you can remember beats a short string you cannot — and until a mail server is configured, nobody can reset it for you.
fr_workspace_help: The workspace everything belongs to. It can be renamed later.
fr_email_help: This is how you sign in to this installation. It stays on this machine.
fr_short: That password is too short. Twelve characters at least.
fr_taken: This installation was set up while you were on this page. Sign in instead.
fr_offline: The server did not answer. It may not be running yet.
fr_failed: Something went wrong setting up. Nothing was created, so you can try again.
fr_already_title: This installation is already set up
fr_already_body: An account exists on this machine, so first run is over. Sign in with it.
ai_blurb: A cloud model answers with your own API key. A local model would run on this machine. Either can be changed later in Settings.
ai_cloud_body: Connect an endpoint with your own API key. The key is stored encrypted on this machine and nowhere else.
ai_local_body: Run a private model on this computer, with no key and no traffic leaving it.
ai_skip: Skip for now — without a model the agent still takes messages
cloud_blurb: Pick an endpoint, name the model, paste the key. Saving stores the key encrypted on this machine and asks the model for one token to prove it answers.
cloud_base_url_help: An OpenAI-compatible base URL. A preset fills it in; any compatible endpoint works, including one on your own network.
cloud_key_help: Stored encrypted on this machine. It never appears in full again — only its last four characters.
cloud_reached: The model answered. The agent is ready.
cloud_refused: The endpoint refused the request. Check the key and the model name.
cloud_unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check the endpoint, and that this machine can reach it.
cloud_no_key: This installation has no encryption key, so credentials cannot be stored. The server log says how to add one.
cloud_failed: Saving failed. Nothing was stored, so you can try again.
cloud_saved_note: The settings are saved even though the test did not pass. You can continue and fix them later in Settings.
